items.question: Does the UAE Virtual digital pleading service let litigants submit statements to the courts without any limitation of location or time?
items.gold: Yes, it enables litigants to submit statements and requests using digital channels without any limitations of location or time.
items.fact: Virtual digital pleading allows submissions without location or time limits

items.question: How many hours a day is the UAE Virtual digital pleading platform available to litigants?
items.fact: Virtual digital pleading platform is available 24/7
